purpose: Canonical immutable-style evidence shape used when a Phase 12 roadmap step is genuinely certified. State/preflight files do not substitute for a completion record.

required_fields.certified_against_head: full Git commit SHA that was actually subjected to the step gate/evidence
required_fields.gate: tool/workflow/manual evidence authority that produced the pass
required_fields.evidence: non-empty object or array containing step-specific evidence

invariants: roadmap_step matches the filename and the gate being certified
certified_against_head names a real commit and must be an ancestor of later aggregate evidence HEADs
evidence is non-empty and derives from the real step gate or required external process
completion record is created only after the step-specific completion requirements are satisfied
preflight/in_progress state never produces a completion record
artifact source commit may be older than the evidence commit; do not require a self-referential HEAD equality
